2. Converted body_mass_g from text to numeric (handled '4,925' format)
3. Excluded 3 rows with body_mass_g values outside valid range [2500, 6500] (rows 9, 20, 49)
4. Excluded 1 row with flipper_length_mm value -181.0 outside valid range [170, 235] (row 1)
5. Removed 1 exact duplicate row (row 59)

After fixes, analyzed 60 rows to compute average body mass by sex:
- Female: 3792.86 grams
- Male: 4492.0 grams
